name: health
description: System health check + self-healing. action='check' (default): DB integrity, tool manifests, memory, semaphore, active requests. action='restart': soft-restart services without killing process. action='cleanup': prune stale workspace index caches older than max_age_days (rebuildable via reindex). Set stats=true for usage statistics.

action.description: check: run health checks. restart: soft-restart services (GC + reinit) to recover from bad state. cleanup: prune stale workspace index caches (rebuildable) older than max_age_days.

stats.description: Include usage statistics: per-tool call counts, success rate, tokens saved, issues caught

max_age_days.description: For action='cleanup': prune workspace caches not accessed within this many days (default 14).

dry_run.description: For action='cleanup': report what would be pruned without deleting (default false).
